entities.summary: Moshoeshoe II, a notable figure in the history of Lesotho, associated with Independence and Early Political Struggles (1960–1966). Preceded by Basutoland Congress and Lesotho Independence 1966. Their legacy influenced Jonathan Suspends Constitution 1970 and Leabua Jonathan's Authoritarian Rule.
